info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Account Recovery API
info.description: The Account Recovery API facilitates the recovery process for customer accounts, enabling users to securely update their account details following a recovery request. This API allows authorized personnel to modify recovery parameters, ensuring that customers regain access to their accounts with proper verification. Common consumers of this API include banking service providers and customer support teams, who utilize it to assist clients in preventing unauthorized access and ensuring smooth account recovery. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer experience and maintain account security.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of account recovery information for a specific customer. Use this to ensure that account recovery settings are up-to-date and accurately reflect the customer's preferences.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the account recovery process for a specific customer identified by the account number. It allows for the modification of account recovery details, ensuring secure access to the account.
